decision_rationale: The section describes a chat model built on Mistral 7B with an autoregressive objective and fine-tuning to generate answers from transcriptome-derived token embeddings. It also notes large-scale training on publicly available datasets and 1,082,213 question-answer pairs.
evidence_snippet: optimized the LLM and the transcriptome-token adapter to generate the corresponding answers using the original autoregressive learning objective of the Mistral LLM; trained on 1,082,213 question-answer pairs and publicly available datasets from GEO and CELLxGENE Census, with Mistral 7B as the basis for the chat model.
